en.title: When your metrics drift
en.shortdesc: A saved report references semantic objects that evolve independently. Treat the ref like a public API and the drift problem mostly solves itself.
en.longdesc: Part 7 of a series on building a semantic-layer report engine: treating semantic refs as a public API, aliases for renames, per-block degradation, and a CI gate that fails the pull request instead of production.
en.seoTitle: Semantic layer: When your metrics drift
en.seoDescription: Drift and compatibility in a semantic layer: refs as a public API, alias maps, and CI impact analysis. Part 7 of a series on semantic-layer report engines.
